|---|---|---|

| `ScrollTrigger.min.js` | 3.15.0 | GSAP Standard "no charge" license |
| `lenis.min.js` | 1.3.26 | MIT (see `LENIS-LICENSE`) |

To update: `npm i gsap lenis` and copy the `dist` files here.
